fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics declined from June high of KRW 374,500 to intraday low of KRW 204,500 on October 15, recently seeking direction around KRW 215,500, with analyst price targets showing wide dispersion of KRW 270,000–KRW 670,000
fields.summary_ko.1: FY2026 Q3 provisional results recorded revenue of approximately KRW 195 trillion, operating income of KRW 107.4 trillion (operating margin approximately 55%), but stock price underwent significant adjustment despite favorable results
fields.summary_ko.2: Bullish analysts including Nomura Securities (KRW 670,000) and KB Securities (KRW 600,000) cite prolonged AI memory supply shortage and HBM4 share gains, while BNK Investment Securities (KRW 270,000) points to memory demand slowdown and supply concerns
